title: Elimination of Unrealised Profits and Losses on Transactions with Associates
summary: Clarified how to measure the investor's share of unrealised profits and losses on transactions with associates under the equity method. Withdrawn in 2003.

related.title: Investments in Associates and Joint Ventures
related.relationship: The parent standard whose 2003 revision superseded SIC-3 by incorporating the elimination principle directly into the equity method guidance
